primary_target: GitHub origin/main as committed, not the uncommitted separation fix
secondary_target: Current locally corrected deployed pipeline; separately labelled

sampling.guitarset: exact archived 1s grid starting .5s; legacy 50ms+4096/44100 boundary margin; nominal/performed separately
sampling.idmt: same six guitar timbres, all 273 midpoint samples each; no non_guitar included
sampling.transitions: native24Hz output, separate from stable sampling

normalization: verbatim legacy root+pitch-class set exact; inversion/octave not independently scored; N/X/unparsed excluded and counted; parsed OOV retained
quality: relative pitch-class interval set equality regardless root; ref OOV retained in denominator
ambiguity: A native stable raw top1; B ambiguous output is abstention for strict top1, not oracle credit

variants.A: native rows.top3[0], before cleanup/context/onset/presentation; model and max pooling unchanged
variants.B: native onset_presentation.display_candidates, default onset/context/grid enabled, no manual BPM/capo/edits/vision
variants.U_context: onset_context display before prepare; diagnostic only, already contains earlier cleanup
variants.B_frame: frame_display_candidates before final beat quantization; diagnostic only

causal_limit: A/B is the complete postprocessing stack ablation, NOT isolated Look-Ahead. Context includes neighbors/keys/bass/arpeggio/dyad/mix rules. U/B_frame diagnostics separate late stages without reimplementing.
timing: actual analyze wall and write_result timing for B; shared feature runtime + separately timed native raw predictions for A. Independent A full end-to-end is NOT executed; do not call a reconstructed sum a measured wall time.
selection: all180 archived GuitarSet comp recordings processed; 2 known timing files excluded only from primary aggregation; all6 archived IDMT guitar files; no outcome-based selection
C: not executed: these datasets have no synchronized video/vision labels
transitions_policy: adjacent normalized distinct labelled events; detect old/new exact chord within 0.5s either side, clamped to intervals. Report all and stable>=0.5s; postprocessing losses are transitions detected at U_context but missed at B_frame/B, distinct from raw pitch errors.
short_run: nonempty chord run <.2s at24Hz; report count independently from accuracy
failures: record every file failure; evaluable samples of failed files count as incorrect/abstain; integrity mismatch separately marked
data_seen: development datasets previously examined; no unseen-test or performer holdout claim; Basic Pitch training data may overlap GuitarSet
